name: Stars Beneath the Water
introDiscord:
The stars are underneath you.

Not reflected.

Actually underneath you.

Shizuki's journal begins:

'Okay.

WHO PUT SKY DOWN THERE.'
introTwitch:
The stars are underneath you.

Not reflected.

Actually underneath you.

Shizuki's journal begins:

'Okay.

WHO PUT SKY DOWN THERE.'

stars-beneath-the-water-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across Stars Beneath the Water.

left.message:
Star Candies float among literal stars.

The branding feels excessive.

right.message: A tiny sun beneath the water warms a restorative current.
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: A Starbelow Angler disguises its lure as one of the stars.

stars-beneath-the-water-depths.prompt: Deeper within Stars Beneath the Water, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

right.message:
One Berry floats beside Shizuki's astronomy chart.

It contains one entry:

'That one looks like Berry.

Glimmer says every constellation cannot be Berry.

Incorrect.'

forward.message: A cache rests on what appears to be the underside of the night sky.

stars-beneath-the-water-threshold.prompt: Near Inverted Firmament, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: Star Candies drift past an inverted moon.

right.message: A Starbelow Angler rises from below the stars.

forward.message:
A warm little sun restores your strength.

Shizuki named it:

'SUN JR.'
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

bossPromptDiscord:
Inverted Firmament darkens.

One enormous false sun begins moving between the stars.

Use /yes to enter or /no to avoid celestial bodies with
teeth.
bossPromptTwitch:
Inverted Firmament darkens.

One enormous false sun begins moving between the stars.

Use !yes to enter or !no to avoid celestial bodies with
teeth.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Inverted Firmament. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The false sun opens into a luminous lure.

Under-Sun Angler reveals itself!

completionText:
The real stars return.

They remain underneath you.

Nobody fixed that.
